}}'''Ronelle''' is an [[Accepted]] with the [[Aes Sedai]] in [[Salidar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ronelle}}

== Strength and Abilities ==
Ronelle has a potential strength in the [[One Power]] of {{opsl|28}}, which would be [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|average]] for an Aes Sedai. It is not certain if she would have reached her full potential yet.

She would not be strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]] unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

== History==
Born in the year {{ne|969}}, she became [[novice]] in the year 984 and [[Accepted]] in 993. In the year 999 she was taken by [[rebel Aes Sedai|rebel Sisters]] and brought to [[Salidar]]. Ronelle would have been tested for the shawl if she had remained in the White Tower.

== Activities ==
She was almost strangled by a sheet when a [[Bubble of evil]] erupted in Salidar, but was saved by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]].

== Speculation ==
Given Ronelle would have tested for the shawl had the Tower split not occurred, and the necessity for full sisters at the [[Last Battle]], it's likely she was given the test for Aes Sedai as soon as possible after reunification.
